comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
The price of ship determinates as this:
Base price you can buy from shipyard, lets say it is 100%. If you have ship building skills to build the ship, at same material, shipbuilder gets 40% discount. i.e. 60% of the cost you buy directly from shipyard. If you sell the ship back to shipyard. The price that NPC pays you is 50% of the original price. High rank shipbuilders can add/take away cargo when they build the ship. For example, a rank 15 shipbuilder can at 15% extra cargo to the ship, while paying 15% extra cost to the npc. Changing the ship materials may also have effect to the cost. Please back to the list about to see the materials and cost %.

Just to make an example, if a ship costs 1m to buy directly from shipyard. R15 shipbuilder pay 600k if he make the ship at standard cargo and material, or 600k x 1.15 = 690k to make. Then if you sell the ship back to the shipyard. The ship with standard cargo worth 500k, or 575k with 15% cargo.

The price list on the above table is already the build cost for shipbuilder, already have the 40% discount for standard cargo.

Since this ship cant not be bought directly from the shipyard. So it doesn't tell the base price. You can go to have a look/refer to other ship like Big trading carrack (trade level 28).
You can see there is a row: at "buy ship", " Red Pine", price "1840000".
And then the next row: at "Build Ship", sowing price "1104000", which is exactly 60% of the "buy ship price". Then the table for all different material at the ship builder price (40% off) with different materials

comments.body: i still confuse of how many skill a ship can have , how many optional skill , original skill and inheritance can a ship have each ?

comments.author: Rex
comments.body:
A ship can have a max of 6 skills active:
2 from normal improving + 1 from original slot + 2 from grade bonusses ( Skill slot addition 1, 2) + 1 from inheritance (grade bonus as well)
